title: Minimum Window Substring
statementHtml: Given two strings s and t. Find the smallest window substring of s that includes all characters in t (including duplicates) , in the window. Return the empty string "" if no such substring exists.
examples:
Input : s = "ADOBECODEBANC" , t = "ABC"

Output : "BANC"

Explanation : The minimum window substring of string s that contains the string t is "BANC".

Input : s = "a" , t = "a"

Output : "a"

Explanation : The complete string is the minimum window
constraintsHtml:
• 1 <= n , m <= 105
  • n = s.length
  • m = t.length
  • string s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase letters.
